nodes.author: jaim_harlow
MeeshFL
nodes.text: @jaim_harlow @InformedNJNurse I haven’t tried clove oil but will definitely add it to my stash. I do 5 drops of oil of oregano in hot water 2-3 times a day when I have anything yuck running through me. I recently switched to the pills because my kids refused to drink oil of oregano 😆

nodes.author: jaim_harlow
nodes.text:
@MeeshFL @InformedNJNurse We go very easy with the oregano oil…it’ll  destroy  the  microbiome  of  your  healthy  bacteria  if  overused.

Generally,  whenever  we  experience  sniffles,  we  hit  it  with  Thyme  and  Oregano  oil  (they  hit  different  bacteria).    Clove  for  respiratory  bacteria
